messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Gateway planning. @lead propose the rate limit for public clients.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Public clients get a rate limit of 100 requests per minute per key.

messages.speaker: reviewer
messages.text: Should we measure real traffic before fixing a number?

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Raise it: the public rate limit is now 300 requests per minute per key. The 100 per minute limit broke the mobile app last week.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: The gateway itself runs on Kong for now.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: We are moving the gateway off Kong to Envoy; Envoy is the gateway from today.

messages.speaker: reviewer
messages.text: Kong's admin UI was nicer, but Envoy stays.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Client authentication uses static API keys.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: We are replacing static API keys with OAuth2 client credentials for all clients. Existing API keys stop working on June 30.

messages.speaker: reviewer
messages.text: Project rule: every public endpoint needs an OpenAPI spec entry before it can merge.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: A partner asked if they could keep using their API key past June. Declined; OAuth2 client credentials are the only option.

messages.speaker: reviewer
messages.text: Load test summary: at 300 requests per minute per key the gateway p99 stays under 40 ms.
